```{r}
library(tidycensus)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(sf)

census_key <- readLines("../../../repos/ds212-hw-alamb378/hw03/src/census_api_key")


# Disable spherical geometry issues during spatial joins
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# 1. Define Race Suffixes & Variables (Same as before)
races <- c(
  "A" = "White Alone",
  "B" = "Black or African American Alone",
  "C" = "American Indian and Alaska Native Alone",
  "D" = "Asian Alone",
  "E" = "Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific Islander Alone",
  "F" = "Some Other Race Alone",
  "G" = "Two or More Races",
  "H" = "White Alone, Not Hispanic or Latino",
  "I" = "Hispanic or Latino"
)

vars_to_pull <- c()
for (code in names(races)) {
  vars_to_pull <- c(
    vars_to_pull,
    setNames(paste0("B19013", code, "_001"), paste0("median_", code)),
    setNames(paste0("B19025", code, "_001"), paste0("agg_inc_", code)),
    setNames(paste0("B19001", code, "_001"), paste0("hh_count_", code))
  )
}

target_states <- c("GA", "MN", "MI", "MO", "LA", "PA")
target_fips <- c(
  "13121", # Fulton County, GA (Atlanta) - add "13089" if you also want DeKalb
  "27123", # Ramsey County, MN (St. Paul)
  "26163", # Wayne County, MI (Detroit)
  "29510", # St. Louis city, MO (Independent City)
  "22071", # Orleans Parish, LA (New Orleans)
  "42003"  # Allegheny County, PA (Pittsburgh)
)

# 2. Example: Pull Tract-Level Data for Ramsey County (St. Paul, MN) with Geometry
tract_raw <- get_acs(
  geography = "tract",
  variables = vars_to_pull,
  state = target_states,
  year = 2024,
  survey = "acs5",
  output = "wide",
  key = census_key,
  geometry = TRUE # Downloads tract boundary polygons
)%>%
  filter(substr(GEOID, 1, 5) %in% target_fips)

# 1. Separate geometry so tidyr pivoting runs cleanly on a plain tibble
tract_geom <- tract_raw %>%
  select(GEOID, geometry)

# 2. Clean and reshape the tabular data
tract_clean <- tract_raw %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(GEOID, NAME, ends_with("E")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("median_", "agg_inc_", "hh_count_")),
    names_to = c("metric", "race_code"),
    names_pattern = "^(median|agg_inc|hh_count)_([A-I])E$",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = metric,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    county_fips = substr(GEOID, 1, 5),
    city = case_when(
      county_fips == "13121" ~ "Atlanta",
      county_fips == "27123" ~ "St. Paul",
      county_fips == "26163" ~ "Detroit",
      county_fips == "29510" ~ "St. Louis",
      county_fips == "22071" ~ "New Orleans",
      county_fips == "42003" ~ "Pittsburgh"
    ),
    race = recode(race_code, !!!races),
    mean_income = if_else(hh_count > 0, round(agg_inc / hh_count, 0), NA_real_)
  )  |> 
  select(
    GEOID,
    city,
    county_fips,
    tract_name = NAME,
    race_code,
    race,
    households = hh_count,
    median_income = median,
    mean_income
  )

# 3. Re-attach geometry if you are mapping or doing spatial joins
tract_clean_sf <- tract_geom %>%
  right_join(tract_clean, by = "GEOID")

#write_sf(tract_clean_sf, "../data/raw/clean_income_data.shp")

#Try later

# Match tract center-points to neighborhood polygons
```

```{r}
library(tidycensus)

historical_redlining_indacator <- read.dbf("../data/raw/HRI2020.dbf", as.is = TRUE)

tract_HRI_sf <- income_data_sf |> 
  left_join(historical_redlining_indacator |> 
              mutate(GEOID = GEOID20) |> 
              select(GEOID, HRI2020, RHRI2020), join_by(GEOID)
```

```{r}
library(ISLR)
library(SmartEDA)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(spdep)

tracts_sf <- read_sf("../data/processed/tract_HRI_sf.shp")

# 1. Read the .dbf file directly (automatically converts '****' to NA)
df <- read.dbf("../data/processed/tract_HRI_sf.dbf", as.is = TRUE)

# Convert categorical variables to factors for SmartEDA & ISLR modeling
df$race_cd <- as.factor(df$race_cd)
df$race    <- as.factor(df$race)

# 2. SmartEDA: High-level dataset overview (rows, columns, missingness)
ExpData(data = df, type = 1)

# 3. SmartEDA: Variable-by-variable structure, data types, and % missing
ExpData(data = df, type = 2)

# 4. SmartEDA: Summary statistics for numeric variables (households, income, HRI)
ExpNumStat(df, by = "A", Outlier = TRUE, round = 2)

# 5. SmartEDA: Income distribution grouped by race/ethnicity
ExpNumStat(df, by = "G", gp = "race_cd", Outlier = TRUE, round = 2)

# 6. SmartEDA: Categorical frequency tables
ExpCTable(df)

# 7. Generate a full interactive HTML EDA report
ExpReport(df, op_file = "Atlanta_Tracts_EDA.html")
```



```{r}
# 2. Subset to Atlanta and aggregate to 1 row per Census Tract (GEOID)
atlanta_income <- tracts_sf %>%
  filter(city == "Atlanta") %>%
  # Option A: Household-weighted mean across mutually exclusive race groups (A-G)
  filter(race_cd %in% LETTERS[1:7]) %>%
  group_by(GEOID, trct_nm) %>%
  summarise(
    total_hh = sum(hoshlds, na.rm = TRUE),
    weighted_mean_inc = sum(men_ncm * hoshlds, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(hoshlds[!is.na(men_ncm)], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Replace NaN (tracts with 0 households, like Tract 68.01) with NA
  mutate(weighted_mean_inc = ifelse(is.nan(weighted_mean_inc), NA, weighted_mean_inc))

# --- Alternative Option B: Map a specific demographic subset (e.g., Black Alone, race_cd == "B") ---
# atlanta_income <- tracts_sf %>%
#   filter(city == "Atlanta", race_cd == "B") %>%
#   rename(weighted_mean_inc = men_ncm)

# 3. Plot the choropleth map
ggplot(data = atlanta_income) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = weighted_mean_inc), color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    direction = -1,
    labels = dollar_format(),
    na.value = "grey85",
    name = "Mean Income"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Household Income by Census Tract",
    subtitle = "Atlanta, GA (Fulton County) — Household-Weighted Tract Average",
    caption = "Source: tract_HRI_sf | Grey tracts indicate zero households or suppressed data"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, margin = margin(b = 4)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey30", margin = margin(b = 10)),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```


```{r}


# 1. Load spatial data and aggregate to 1 row per Census Tract (GEOID)


# 2. Map A: Historical Redlining Index (HRI2020: 1 = Best/Green, 4 = Hazardous/Red)
atlanta_tracts <- tracts_sf %>%
  filter(city == "Atlanta", race_cd %in% LETTERS[1:7]) %>%
  group_by(GEOID, trct_nm) %>%
  summarise(
    HRI2020 = first(HRI2020),
    total_hh = sum(hoshlds, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_inc = sum(men_ncm * hoshlds, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(hoshlds[!is.na(men_ncm)], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(mean_inc = ifelse(is.nan(mean_inc), NA, mean_inc))

p_hri <- ggplot(atlanta_tracts) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = HRI2020), color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    direction = -1,
    na.value = "grey85",
    name = "HRI (1–4)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Historical Redlining (HRI 2020)",
    subtitle = "Higher scores indicate historically redlined areas"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey30")
  )

# 3. Map B: Household-Weighted Mean Income
p_inc <- ggplot(atlanta_tracts) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = mean_inc), color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "viridis",
    labels = dollar_format(scale = 1e-3, suffix = "k"),
    na.value = "grey85",
    name = "Mean Income"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Household Income",
    subtitle = "Household-weighted tract average ($)"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey30")
  )

# 4. Combine maps side-by-side
(p_hri | p_inc) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Redlining Legacy & Contemporary Income in Atlanta, GA",
    caption = "Source: tract_HRI_sf | Grey tracts indicate missing HRI scores or zero households"
  )
```


```{r}
# --- A. Global Moran's I for Mean Household Income ---
inc_valid <- atlanta_tracts %>% filter(!is.na(mean_inc))

# Build Queen contiguity neighbors and row-standardized spatial weights (style = "W")
nb_inc <- poly2nb(inc_valid, queen = TRUE)
lw_inc <- nb2listw(nb_inc, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

# Run Global Moran's I test (analytical & Monte Carlo permutation)
moran_inc <- moran.test(inc_valid$mean_inc, lw_inc, zero.policy = TRUE)
print(moran_inc)

# Optional: 999-simulation permutation test (robust to skewed income distributions)
moran_inc_mc <- moran.mc(inc_valid$mean_inc, lw_inc, nsim = 999, zero.policy = TRUE)
print(moran_inc_mc)

# --- B. Global Moran's I for HRI2020 ---
# Many suburban Fulton County tracts lack HOLC redlining grades (HRI2020 is NA)
hri_valid <- atlanta_tracts %>% filter(!is.na(HRI2020))

nb_hri <- poly2nb(hri_valid, queen = TRUE)
lw_hri <- nb2listw(nb_hri, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

moran_hri <- moran.test(hri_valid$HRI2020, lw_hri, zero.policy = TRUE)
print(moran_hri)

# --- C. Bivariate Correlation Between HRI2020 and Mean Income ---
both_valid <- atlanta_tracts %>% filter(!is.na(HRI2020), !is.na(mean_inc))
cor.test(both_valid$HRI2020, both_valid$mean_inc, method = "spearman")
```


```{r}
# Calculate Local Moran's I for Mean Income
local_m <- localmoran(inc_valid$mean_inc, lw_inc, zero.policy = TRUE)

# Classify tracts into LISA quadrants (significant at p < 0.05)
inc_scaled <- scale(inc_valid$mean_inc)[, 1]
lag_scaled <- lag.listw(lw_inc, inc_scaled, zero.policy = TRUE)
p_vals     <- local_m[, "Pr(z != E(Ii))"]

inc_valid <- inc_valid %>%
  mutate(
    lisa_cluster = case_when(
      p_vals >= 0.05                     ~ "Not Significant",
      inc_scaled > 0 & lag_scaled > 0    ~ "High-High (Affluent Cluster)",
      inc_scaled < 0 & lag_scaled < 0    ~ "Low-Low (Low-Income Cluster)",
      inc_scaled > 0 & lag_scaled < 0    ~ "High-Low (High Outlier)",
      inc_scaled < 0 & lag_scaled > 0    ~ "Low-High (Low Outlier)"
    )
  )

# Plot LISA Cluster Map
ggplot(inc_valid) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = lisa_cluster), color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "High-High (Affluent Cluster)"   = "#2b5c8f",
      "Low-Low (Low-Income Cluster)"   = "#d95f02",
      "High-Low (High Outlier)"        = "#a6bddb",
      "Low-High (Low Outlier)"         = "#fdb863",
      "Not Significant"                = "grey90"
    ),
    name = "LISA Cluster (p < 0.05)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Local Moran's I (LISA) Clusters — Atlanta Mean Income",
    subtitle = "Statistically significant spatial clustering of household income"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```
